question: What Business Central AL performance guidance applies when reading only some fields from a large table such as Customer for a batch export?
answer: Call SetLoadFields with the normal fields used by the caller and its helpers, immediately before the read (microsoft/knowledge/performance/use-setloadfields-for-partial-records.md); the numeric cutoffs are BCQuality heuristics, not platform thresholds. Apply filters before iterating (…/apply-filters-before-iterating.md). Reset or an empty SetLoadFields restores a full-row load, so set the load list after Reset (…/reset-clears-partial-record-selection.md).
